The '''2015 Rosemount Championship''' (RMC) was held on 13 June 2015 at Rosemount Middle School in Rosemount, Minnesota, for current and former Rosemount players. [[Mark Walseth]] organized it. 36 players entered, nine more than in 2014. [[Jake Nelson]] defended his title, beating [[Sean Miller|Sean]] in the final.<ref name="rmc15">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=58172 RMC 2015 - Rosemount, MN], forum.starwarsccg.org (27 May – 17 June 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004548/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t58172.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Rosemount Middle School, Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="rmc15" />
* '''Date:''' 13 June 2015<ref name="rmc15" />
* '''Structure:''' 5 games modified Swiss (SoS), then 2 rounds of modified match play for the top 4<ref name="rmc15" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="rmc15" />
* '''Field:''' 36 players<ref name="rmc15" />

Bryan was the only player undefeated after the Swiss rounds. In the semi-finals Jake beat Mitch and Sean beat Bryan; Charlie A. streamed the final on Twitch.<ref name="rmc15" />
